verdict.rationale: Pinecone is a core ANN vector search product supporting dense/sparse vector search, configurable scoring (score_by dense_vector, sparse_vector, BM25 text, Lucene query_string), hybrid search fusion, and metadata filtering, corroborated by community users describing combined keyword+vector search and filtering experiences. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming specific distance metric options (e.g., cosine/dot-product/euclidean) and independent benchmark validation of ANN recall/latency tradeoffs.
